question: Can a smooth exact reduced state of dimension less than five preserve the registered future mechanical-interface response map of one adaptive connection locally around the registered interior state?
response_map: Concatenation of (effective_transfer_gain, contractile_capacity) after independently applying each registered probe to the same base state.
defeat_condition: If rank(J_Phi) < 5 under the preregistered numerical criterion, this benchmark does not establish a five-dimensional local lower bound.
survival_condition: If rank(J_Phi) == 5 and numerical stability checks support that rank, then no smooth exact factorization of this registered local future-response map through a state representation of dimension less than five exists locally.
required_controls: all perturbed states remain inside registered bounds
no clamp boundary is crossed by finite-difference state perturbations
rank must be reported together with all singular values
rank stability must be checked at finite-difference steps 1e-5, 1e-6, and 1e-7 without changing the primary registered step
forbidden_post_result_changes: changing the base state because the observed rank is undesirable
changing probe identities because the observed rank is undesirable
changing probe amplitude because the observed rank is undesirable
changing the primary finite-difference step because the observed rank is undesirable
changing the rank threshold because the observed rank is undesirable
adding new observables after seeing the result
reading hidden state coordinates directly as output observables
